question: How to shift/change curricular program?
candidate_answer:
To shift/change curricular program, you must first secure a shifting form from your current college and one from the OSAS, and then undergo advising (consultation) at the OSAS with your College Guidance Practitioner.
The Shifting forms must be approved by the College Dean and by the College Guidance Practitioner. After approval, you must submit the approved shifting forms to the registrar’s office.
If you are requesting to shift to another college, you must submit a request to shift in the prescribed form, which must be approved by the Dean of the College where you are enrolled and the Dean of the College where you intend to shift.
If you are requesting to shift within the same college, the request must be endorsed by the Department Head of the course where you are enrolled, and then approved by the Dean. The approved requests shall be submitted to the Office of the University Registrar for recording.

B. the dropping from shall be filled out accordingly and have it approved by the class adviser and respective Dean.
C. the approved dropping form shall be furnished to corresponding Offices." Recorded source limitation: "Unavailable information: source-specific DAC fees do not establish a universal charge." Please confirm with the relevant university office.
To shift, take your request to the Deans of your current college and the college you want to shift to (if moving to another college), the Department Head of your course (if staying within the same college), the College Guidance Practitioner and the Office of the University Registrar, as the Handbook prints. Bintanong cannot evaluate your credits or approve a shift; those offices decide.
